div.head: II Em 2
div.ab: Gif hwa cyrican gesece oððe mine burh, ⁊ hine man ðær sece oððe yflyge: ða þe ðæt doð, syn ðæs ylcon scyldige, ðe hit her beforan cwæð.
Gif hwa cyrcan gesece oððe mine burh, ⁊ hine man ðær sece oððe yflige: ða ðe þæt don, syn ðæs ylcon scyldige, ðe hit her beforan cweð.
Si quis ecclesiam requirat uel burgum meum et ibi assalliatur uel affligatur: qui hoc fecerint, sint eiusdem culpabiles, quod supra dictum est.
[Be ðon ðe mon oþerne on cyricean gesece oþþe on cyninges burh.] Gif hwa cyrcan gesece oððe mine burh ⁊ hine man ðær sece oððe yflige—ða ðe ðæt don syn ðæs ylcon scyldige ðe hit her beforan cweð.

(Davon, dass man jemanden in Kirche oder Königsburg belangt. Ld) Wenn jemand [Asyl suchend] eine Kirche oder meine Burg erreicht, und man ihn dort belangt oder schädigt: die, welche das thun, seien desselben schuldig, wie es hier zuvor lautet.

(Of attacking someone in a church or a royal residence. Ld) If anyone [seeking sanctuary] reaches a church or my residence, and he is attacked or harmed there: let those who do that be liable to the same as is stated here above.
If anyone flees [for sanctuary] to a church or to my premises, and anyone attacks or injures him there, those who do so shall incur the penalty which has already been stated.
If anyone flees to a church or my residence, and he is attacked or molested there, those who do it are to be liable to the same penalty as is stated above.

note.seg: Be ðon ðe mon oþerne on cyricean gesece oþþe on cyninges burh Rubrik Ld
Be ðon ðe mon oþerne on cyricean gesece oþþe on cyninges burh rubric Ld
Vgl. Gl friedlos 10b; Asylbruch 6. Die Strafe hier ist strenger als bei Früheren, erklärbar weniger durchs Asyl als durch den Königsfrieden; s. d. Gl 4a
Cf. Gl friedlos 10b; Asylbruch 6. The penalty here is harsher than under earlier lawgivers, to be explained less by asylum than by the king’s peace; see that word in Gl 4a
Asyl (s. d. Gl 14a) durch Adel bleibt hier unerwähnt.—‘Burg’ bed. hier nur ‘festes Haus’
Asylum (see that word in Gl 14a) conferred by nobility is not mentioned here.—‘Burg’ here means only ‘fortified house’
Dasselbe Wort in diesem Zusammenhange Af 2, 1
The same word in this context Af 2, 1
i.e. outlawry and forfeiture of property.
